title: Hand-labeled stance reference for face splitting
labeler: Hand labels by a Cursor cloud agent reading the post text. No paid labeling API.

live_data_json.note: Global top 10 from origin/data-snapshot public/data.json. This is the file the 2026-10-10 daily run published.

corpus.note: Face membership for today's planets. Face sizes match the published faces exactly.

not_used_for_membership.note: The #104 corpus. Its top 10 is a different day (Israeli Genocide, Ukraine Russia Conflict, ICE Voter Surveillance). It does not contain Trump Putin Diesel Deal, Rise of Fascism, or ICE Abuse, so today's posts were not labeled from it.

sample_method: Within each published face, posts are ordered by distance to the face and then by URI. The sample takes evenly spaced posts across that order, including both ends. Planets with fewer than 40 posts are labeled in full. Labels are supports, opposes, other-angle, or off-topic, against the planet's stance question. supports and opposes are the two coherent poles. other-angle is on the subject but is not a yes or no. off-topic is a different subject.
second_stance_rule: A second coherent stance is the largest of supports or opposes that is not the sample's plurality. If the plurality is other-angle or off-topic, the largest pole itself is that second stance. The 10% line is second_coherent_n / sample_n >= 0.10. other-angle is not treated as one stance, because those posts do not share a claim.
michael_2026_10_10: One face is OK only if that is the reality. He suspects real distinct perspectives are being missed and does not want one face as the easy, low-error default.
